name: Being Emotionally Whole
overview: Scripture reveals that being emotionally whole begins with seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, trusting that He will provide for our needs (Matthew 6:33). The foundation of this wholeness is faith in Jesus Christ, who is the way to the Father and the source of eternal life (John 3:16; John 14:6). Though believers face trials in this world, Christ offers peace and courage through His victory over the world (John 16:33). Repentance, baptism, and receiving the Holy Spirit are essential steps in experiencing the fullness of God's grace and emotional restoration (Acts 2:38), while recognizing that God's commands are not burdensome but life-giving (Acts 15:10).
